entities.name: 单向门决策 (one-way door)
entities.how_described: Brian 说 HubSpot 每次事情慢下来、出现流失，通常是因为他桌上有艰难的单向门决策没做，一旦打开或关上那扇门，所有人就解脱了、开始快得多地移动。

evidence.quote: It was because there were some hard one-way door type decisions on my desk, and maybe every year I would sit down and I'd open that one-way door or close it, and it just freed everyone up and we just started moving so much faster.
